name: Faculty of Law
general_notes: The Faculty annually awards the degrees BA (Law), BCom (Law), LLB, LLM and LLD. The following matric equivalents are not accepted in the Faculty of Law: NCV, NASCA, ASC.

programmes.name: BA (LAW)
programmes.minimum_aps_text: 31 with Mathematics OR 32 with Mathematical Literacy
programmes.career: Legal Advisor, Career in Public Administration.
programmes.notes: After completing a 3 year BA (Law) degree students can register for an LLB degree and complete it within a further 2 years.

programmes.name: BCOM (LAW)
programmes.notes: After completing a 3 year BCom (Law) degree students can register for an LLB degree and complete it within a further 2 years.

programmes.name: LLB
programmes.minimum_aps_text: 31 with Mathematics OR 32 with Mathematical Literacy
programmes.career: Advocate, Attorney, State Advocate, Legal Advisor, Magistrate, Public Prosecutor.
programmes.notes: Additional language requirement is waived in the case of international students with a non-South African secondary school-leaver's certificate which does not include a second language.
